sources.entry: Fork - Fast and friendly Git client for Mac.

summary.name: Fork
summary.one_liner: Fork is a Git client for Mac and Windows offering visual commits, diffs, merge-conflict resolution, and interactive rebase.
use_cases: reorder or squash commits with interactive rebase
compare source code and image changes
find which commit changed a file
summary.what_it_does:
Fork is a graphical Git client with a commit list, working directory view, and side-by-side diff viewer. It supports common Git operations such as fetch, pull, push, commit and amend, branch and tag management, checkout, cherry-pick, revert, merge, rebase, stashes, and submodules. Its merge-conflict helper and visual interactive rebase let users resolve conflicts and edit commit history graphically. History and blame views show which commits changed a file or line, and image diffs are supported for common formats. The page also lists Git-flow, Git LFS, and GPG support, plus GitHub notifications.</what_it_does>
